name: B10-0584/2025 (PfE) – Mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Nigeria to free all the students and staff still held after gunmen took at least 303 pupils and 12 staff from St Mary's Catholic School in Papiri on 21 November 2025. It says Nigeria must protect its citizens, keep schools safe, respect freedom of religion, and bring kidnappers to justice. It also asks the European Union and its member states to raise these concerns with Nigeria. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Nigeria's government, kidnapped children and staff, and Christian communities.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends the text to Nigerian authorities and international bodies.
